description: This file implements the NativeJSImplementation class, which manages the lifecycle and operations of a native JavaScript renderer within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes methods for initialization, deinitialization, application creation, execution, and termination, and interacts with a NativeJSRenderer object.

classes.name: NativeJSImplementation
classes.description: A class that provides an interface for managing native JavaScript applications within the plugin, including lifecycle management and communication with the renderer.

methods.name: NativeJSImplementation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service, setting the running state to true.

methods.name: Destructor
methods.description: Destructor that logs the destruction and resets the renderer pointer.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Starts the renderer in a separate thread, initializing it with the provided Wayland display string.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Terminates the renderer and joins the thread if active.

methods.name: CreateApplication
methods.description: Creates a new application with specified options, storing the application ID.

methods.name: RunApplication
methods.description: Runs an application with a given ID and URL.

methods.name: RunJavaScript
methods.description: Executes JavaScript code in the context of a specified application.

methods.name: GetApplications
methods.description: Retrieves the list of current applications.

methods.name: TerminateApplication
methods.description: Terminates the application with the specified ID.
